Midair Strokes.name: Midair Strokes
Midair Strokes.description: For the rest of the scene the user draws on empty air. Each stroke hangs where their fingertip passes and lifts at once into a construct, so with a few flicks they draw a stair up into the sky, a net under a falling crowd or a cage around a target. Constructs drawn this scene do not dissolve in water, but every midair drawing is a quick sketch that breaks under a heavy blow, and the user can still keep only three going at once. When the scene ends their ink is spent until they have slept. Strain: severe.
